span.p:
SQL DB + Ledger shard
1000 crore row, likhai dheemi
-> account_id se data tukdon me: mera balance + history ek tukde pe
mujhse kaatna ek jagah, ek transaction
(shard by account_id)
do account alag shard -> A kaato, B daalo, fail pe ulta (saga)
idempotency key -> account_id se usi shard
